title: Azure DevOps connector is available in Beta
body:
The managed [Azure DevOps connector](/aws/en/ingestion/lakeflow-connect/azure-devops) is now available in Beta in Databricks Lakeflow Connect.

Use the connector to ingest project, repository, work item, build, release, and identity data from Azure DevOps into Databricks. The connector authenticates with a Microsoft Entra service principal and supports incremental ingestion of commits.
